name: JusticeBeaver (Eric Escobar)
biography: (Eric Escobar) is a Security Engineer at Barracuda Networks. His interests are broad and generally include putting computers in places you wouldn't expect. From chicken coops to rockets and even bee hives. Before being called to the dark side, Eric procured a Bachelor's and Master's degree in Civil Engineering. He now enjoys all things wireless, from WiFi, to SDR, and Ham Radio. Last year his team placed 1st in DEF CON 23's Wireless CTF.
